text: Epic complete. The canonical contrast-effect method now composes fit.PreparedContrastGeometry, runwise scan-level sufficient statistics in mvpa-fit, multivar's typed OperatorProgram/CanonicalEffectProblem, Gale's generalized symmetric-definite eigensolver, and ordinary MVPA feature-set/result traversal. Commits 7f130a7, d3f9b85, 0042bf0, e748dde, 0ec200d, aa06e60, f8580a7, ebeb1da, and eaca6c6 provide the complete slice. All five CCA children are closed; focused and repository-wide JVM/Scala.js gates pass; no trialwise beta table, time-by-time projector, generic spectral fork, or CCA-specific execution engine was introduced.
